name: tokeninvest
description: TokenInvest - MVP de investimentos tokenizados com Open Finance e DREX simulado

scripts.dev: npm run compilar && concurrently -n API,WEB -c blue,green "npm run start -w backend" "npm run dev -w frontend"
scripts.test: npm test -w blockchain && npm test -w backend
scripts.resetar-dados: node -e "require('fs').rmSync('backend/data',{recursive:true,force:true});console.log('backend/data/ apagado: o próximo start começa do zero.')"
